name: arxa
description: arxa — Totem Labs' agentic studio harness. A package that DEPENDS on dsh components (depend-don't-fork, arxa-harness-and-distribution.md amendment); never a fork, never a rebase.
//: Versions are EXACT — a caret on a prerelease moves under you (H1 finding 2).
private:true until the outward name check (trademark/domain/npm) — decision 10.
arxa update = bump these pins, run the suite. That is the whole upstream story.
the pi-ai override was dropped at the 0.1.2-rc.1 bump: upstream dsh-llm-pi-ai
now declares ^0.84.2 itself (the issue we filed landed), so the engine's own
range owns pi-ai again — glm-5.3 catalog entries ride it unchanged.
js-yaml (devDependencies) was previously an UNDECLARED transitive dependency
(hoisted only via @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets) that scripts/preset-check.mjs
relies on directly; now declared explicitly, pinned to the major already
hoisted in node_modules (4.3.1) so a future install cannot silently stop
hoisting it flat. devDependencies, not dependencies: only the dev-time
check script imports it — bin/arxa-studio.mjs and bin/materialise-preset.mjs
do not use js-yaml at runtime.
dsh-agent-presets was the SAME undeclared-transitive shape as js-yaml above:
hoisted only, but .claude/skills/ symlinks into it for the two cordis skills
and scripts/preset-check.mjs mirrors its health check. Declared explicitly at
the version already hoisted (0.1.2-rc.1) so a future install cannot move it
and silently dangle those symlinks.
dsh-sandbox + dsh-sandbox-policy are devDependencies for the same reason as
dsh-agent-presets above: host-plane plugins and scripts import them bare
(plugins/sandbox, scripts/s1-sandbox-verify) and resolve from THIS tree in
tests — declared at the pin so a fresh install cannot serve another wave.
The 2026-09-15 stale-root purge made the accidental resolution loud.
js-yaml moved to dependencies at the 0.1.5 bump: dsh-app-boot imports it at
engine boot (a host-provided peer of the wave). It used to ship only
because the pre-trim payload tarred every devDependency.
